synopsis: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Treasures from Batuu is a canon reference book and merchandise box set and will feature information paired with replica objects related to the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge parks. Full of treasures from Black Spire Outpost, Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Treasures from Batuu offers unique items inspired by Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Learn about Batuu's secrets and locales - from Oga's Cantina to Savi's Workshop - and gather one-of-a-kind items along the way, including high-quality stickers, keychains, and a collectible button. An essential addition to your Star Wars collection, Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Treasures from Batuu will transport you to the exciting world of Batuu! COLLECT A DOZEN UNIQUE ARTIFACTS: This kit will delight Star Wans fans of all ages with one-of-a-kind items such as high-quality stickers, keychains, and a collectible pin. EXPERIENCE THE IMMERSIVE WORLD OF BATUU: Journey to the planet Batuu, a remote hideout populated by Resistance heroes such as Rey and Chewbacca, as well as Kylo Ren and his First Order stormtroopers. BUILD YOUR STAR WARS COLLECTION: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Treasures from Batuu joins Star Wars: Jedi Artifacts, Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: The Official Black Spire Outpost Cookbook, and Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection in Insight Editions' line of fan-favorite Star Wars books.
title: Galaxy's Edge: Treasures from Batuu
